categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Haoyang Electronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of stage entertainment lighting equipment, architectural lighting equipment, and trusses. The company serves the cultural and entertainment sectors with products used in theaters, concert venues, TV studios, and urban landscape lighting. It also manufactures aluminum alloy trusses for stage construction and lighting fixture support.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in optics, electronics, thermal management, mechanical structure, and control systems, holding numerous domestic and international patents. It employs both order-based and non-order-based production methods, with a focus on ODM and OBM sales models. Advanced R&D efforts include digital and intelligent lighting control, high-power LED and laser stage lighting, and lightweight, waterproof designs, supported by comprehensive quality and supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include TV stations, theaters, sports arenas, entertainment venues, tourism performance operators, and lighting rental companies domestically. Internationally, customers are professional stage lighting and architectural lighting distributors and buyers across Asia, Africa, South America, the Middle East, and Eastern Europe. The company also participates in large-scale cultural and sports events globally, enhancing its market presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Guangzhou, and has expanded overseas with subsidiaries in Denmark, the United States, Vietnam, Hong Kong, France, and Germany. Its international sales cover Asia, Africa, South America, the Middle East, Eastern Europe, and other global markets, supported by direct sales and distributor networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haoyang Electronic operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales of lighting equipment and related structural components. It maintains stable upstream supplier relationships for raw materials and outsources non-core processing tasks, while controlling core technology and production internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in stage and intelligent lighting technologies, investing heavily in R&D to develop new products such as high-power laser stage lights, multi-functional LED moving heads, and advanced lighting control systems. It pursues digitalization, intelligent control, and lightweight design, while expanding patent portfolios and collaborating with academic and cultural institutions to enhance technological and cultural integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales under ODM and OBM models, both domestically and internationally. Sales include direct sales and distributor-based sales, with a focus on customized, high-technology lighting solutions. The company also earns income from accessories and related services, with no subscription or licensing revenue reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly fragmented global market dominated by established European and American brands with long R&D histories. Haoyang has strengthened its competitive position through technological innovation, brand development, and international expansion, becoming a recognized player in the professional stage and architectural lighting industry, especially within the Chinese and emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.21 billion, a 7.12% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 301.7 million, down 17.61%. Despite a slight decline in revenue and profit, the company has expanded its asset base and overseas subsidiaries, with ongoing investments in production capacity and R&D indicating a growth-oriented trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haoyang Electronic differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, extensive patent holdings, and integration of cultural elements into product design. Its products offer high reliability, customization, intelligent control, and superior optical and thermal performance. The company’s strong cultural collaborations and participation in major international events enhance its brand value and customer loyalty, positioning it as a technology-driven and culturally integrated lighting solutions provider.
